queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows (error or exception or timeout or fail)
| parse "EventCode = *;" as EventCode
| parse "Computer = \"*\";" as Computer
| parse "Message = \"*\";" as Message
| _raw as raw_text
| if(raw_text matches "*error*", "error_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*Error*", "error_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*exception*", "exception_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*Exception*","exception_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*timeout*", "timeout_keyword", if(raw_text matches "*fail*", "fail_keyword","no_error_keywords")))))) as keyword_tag
|where if ("{{raw_text}}" = "*", true, raw_text matches "{{raw_text}}") AND if ("{{keyword_tag}}" = "*", true, keyword_tag matches "{{keyword_tag}}") AND if ("{{message}}" = "*", true, message matches "{{message}}") AND if ("{{_sourcecategory}}" = "*", true, _sourcecategory matches "{{_sourcecategory}}")
|count by keyword_tag

| transpose row _timeslice column keyword_tag
| fillmissing timeslice(15m)

panels.title: Keyword Tag
panels.text: ## If a Windows event message contains "error", "timeout", "exception", or "fail" Sumo tags the message with "error_keyword", "timeout_keyword", "exception_keyword", or "fail_keyword" respectively.

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows (error or exception or timeout or fail)
| parse "EventCode = *;" as EventCode
| parse "Computer = \"*\";" as Computer
| parse "Message = \"*\";" as Message
| _raw as raw_text
| if(raw_text matches "*error*", "error_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*Error*", "error_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*exception*", "exception_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*Exception*","exception_keyword",if(raw_text matches "*timeout*", "timeout_keyword", if(raw_text matches "*fail*", "fail_keyword","no_error_keywords")))))) as keyword_tag
| timeslice 24h
|where if ("{{raw_text}}" = "*", true, raw_text matches "{{raw_text}}") AND if ("{{keyword_tag}}" = "*", true, keyword_tag matches "{{keyword_tag}}") AND if ("{{message}}" = "*", true, message matches "{{message}}") AND if ("{{_sourcecategory}}" = "*", true, _sourcecategory matches "{{_sourcecategory}}")
|logreduce by _timeslice
| sort by _count
